Name: Witch's Broom - Updated for Content Patcher
Author: Queina1
Description:
Strawberrymilk95 has given me permission to update their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/499]Witch's Broom[/url] mod for 1.5 and content patcher. I recommend pairing it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5780]No Clop If It's Not A Horse[/url], to remove the horse gallop sound. 

If you like this mod, please take a moment to endorse it. Thank you.

Manifest.Description: A broomstick to replace your horse
